# sources.txt is regenerated by scripts/list_sources.py whenever .cpp
# files are added or removed; reading the committed file means CMake
# only reconfigures when the list itself changes.
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS sources.txt)
file(STRINGS sources.txt MINECRAFT_SOURCES)

plce_add_library(plce_minecraft SOURCES ${MINECRAFT_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(plce_minecraft
    PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
           ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/..
)

target_link_libraries(plce_minecraft
    PUBLIC  plce_nbt
            plce_java
            plce_util
            plce_assets_localisation
            plce_platform_sound
            plce_platform_renderer
            plce_platform_renderer_ui
            plce_platform_renderer_world
            plce_platform_input
            plce_platform_profile
            plce_platform_storage
            plce_platform_fs
            plce_platform_thread
    PRIVATE ZLIB::ZLIB
            glm::glm
)

if(TARGET GLEW::GLEW)
    target_link_libraries(plce_minecraft PRIVATE GLEW::GLEW)
endif()

if(APPLE)
    target_link_libraries(plce_minecraft
        PRIVATE "-framework Metal"
                "-framework MetalKit"
                "-framework QuartzCore"
                "-framework IOKit"
    )
endif()

target_precompile_headers(plce_minecraft PRIVATE
    <string> <vector> <memory> <cstdint> <cstddef>
    <algorithm> <array> <functional> <unordered_map>
    <glm/glm.hpp>
)
